newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-ANDERLECHT GAME TO BE REPLAYED DUE TO PUNCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ANDERLECHT GAME TO BE REPLAYED DUE TO PUNCH.

text.p: Anderlecht must replay a match they won 3-0 against Aalst because striker Gilles De Bilde was not sent off after punching an opponent, the Belgian soccer union said on Friday.
"De Bilde was not dismissed because the referee did not see the incident," soccer union spokesman Guido De Windt said.
De Bilde was charged with assault and grievous bodily harm and banned until March 31 after striking Aalst's Krist Porte during the game on December 21.
De Bilde has since been transferred to Dutch first division PSV Eindhoven but Porte, who suffered a broken eye socket and nose, is still sidelined.

The incident occurred when Porte tried to prevent De Bilde from rushing towards goal as Anderlecht's Par Zetterberg took a penalty which made it 2-0. De Bilde, who spent a night in jail after the incident, completed the match.
Anderlecht are fourth and Aalst second from bottom in Belgium's 18-team first division.
